text: Ñalnde Alla mooɓoyta yimɓe ɓen ka Darngal fii hasbugol ɓe, wa'anay ɓe wa si ɓe ñiiɓaano ka nguurndam maɓɓe aduna e cuɗaaji maɓɓe, si wanaa saa'a gooto pet e ñalorma, hara yoga maɓɓe no anndita yoga, hooti ngol anndindirgol taƴa hakkunde maɓɓe hakkee ko ɓe yi'i kon e fiyaaku laakara no tiiɗi. Gomɗii ɓen fennuɓe kawral Joomi maɓɓe ngal Ñalnde Darngal ɓe sooyii, ɓe gomɗinaano immital ka aduna sakko ɓe hisa e sooyugol(perte).
